hypothesis: Independent text cosine scores rank target primitives well but confuse semantically adjacent scene queries. A scale-free per-primitive margin against the strongest competing benchmark query should improve discrimination without changing the compact field, query embeddings, geometry, frozen VALA spatial readout, threshold, or evaluation protocol.

candidate.formula: margin_q = raw_score_q - max(raw_score_j for j != q)
candidate.application_point: independently at every primitive and native scale, before frozen VALA kNN10 smoothing, peak scale selection, per-query min-max/2x-1 remap, and fixed 0.6 threshold

gate.primary: fixed-threshold mIoU must improve on both development scenes
gate.secondary: macro mIoU across the two scenes must improve by at least 0.01
gate.on_failure: reject hard-sibling margin and do not expand to Ramen/Teatime
